title: Blob reference
description: Large payloads (screen captures, attachments, recordings) never travel on the event bus. The bus carries this pointer; the bytes sit in the object store under retention and legal hold controls.

uri.description: s3://bucket/key in the managed plane, or a broker-resolvable opaque handle when the bytes remain in a self hosted estate.

key_id.description: Customer managed key ARN where the tenant requires key custody.

legal_hold.description: When true, retention expiry is suspended and deletion is refused at the store, not at the application.
